featured_reviews.name: Gautam Lodha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Header: Best quality and most professional service as a secretary of Garden Grove Complex at Chikoowadi Borivali West area.

We selected Rangshalaka service for painting and repair works of our two 14 storied towers.

I have below 5 best points to tell about Rangshalaka:

Knowledge: The team seems to have he best of work knowledge due to their years of their service in he market. They guided very well to for the repair work which was required to which colour would be the quality effective and cost effective.

Service: Rangshalaka team is vey professional and knows how to manage such huge project in timely manner. They use they best of knowledge to prioritise and complete section by section work.

Cost effective and Quality: The quotation provide by Rangshalaka was among the lowest and had highest numbers of working points out of the other 4 companies. The use of colour quality, the pattern, the repair work quality and terms were among the best from the rest.

Word of Honour: The time line provided by Rangshalaka was exact, they did not take 1 extra week to finish the work. They stick to their promise and quality work in timely manner is their outmost priority.

Team: I would like to say Rangshalaka has the bestest of team people of Rangshalaka who helped us and monitored each and every work of our building from day one and during tough time of Corona. They took all the precautions and safety of their labourers and other around while working in building.
From office staff to work supervisor to engineer to their labourers, all of them well experienced and professional to the next level.

There were no negative points which we came across during 4 months of our work period.
